name: Post new Shopify products to Instagram and Facebook with Rizamo

parameters.content:
## Post new Shopify products to Instagram and Facebook

### How it works
For shops that announce every new product on social media. When a product is created in Shopify, the workflow checks that it is active and has a photo, so drafts and products still waiting for pictures are skipped.

It then writes a post with the title, a short description, the lowest price and the product's link, and adds up to four photos (more than one makes a carousel). The post goes to a Rizamo profile's queue, and Rizamo publishes it at the profile's next free posting time on the accounts you pick.

A product created as a draft is not posted when it goes live later: this workflow only reads new products.

### Setup
1. Install the verified community node `@rizamohq/n8n-nodes-rizamo` (tested with 0.1.1): open the nodes panel, search **Rizamo** and choose **Install** ([installation guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)).
2. In Rizamo, open **Developers**, create an API key and add it in n8n as a **Rizamo API** credential.
3. Connect Shopify in **New product**.
4. In **Write the post**, set your shop's address and how prices read.
5. In **Add to queue**, pick the profile and its accounts. The profile's posting times are set in Rizamo.
6. Activate the workflow.

### Customization
Change the caption in **Write the post**, or set **When** to Publish Now to post at once.

## Skip drafts and products without photos
Only active products with at least one photo go on.

## Write the post
Title, description, lowest price and link, with up to 4 photos.

## Add it to the queue
Rizamo publishes it at the profile's next free posting time.
